body:
# Colorful Axolotl Buckets YS

Colorful Axolotl Buckets is a lightweight datapack and resource pack that makes axolotl buckets visually match the axolotl inside.

Instead of every axolotl bucket using the same default look, each variant gets its own custom bucket texture and name. Pick up an axolotl with a water bucket, and the bucket updates automatically.

## Features

- Custom bucket visuals for every axolotl variant
- Supports Lucy, Wild, Gold, Cyan, and Blue axolotls
- Works when picking up axolotls in Survival
- Supports Creative Mode pickup behavior
- Includes a give-all command for testing or admin use
- Lightweight and simple — no extra gameplay systems added

## Requirements

This project requires both parts:

- The datapack
- The matching resource pack

The datapack handles detection and item updates.  
The resource pack provides the custom bucket textures.

## Commands

Use this command to view pack info:

```mcfunction
/function cab:systems/info
```
